title: Alert Escalation Patterns
scenario: Find sequences of alert escalations in a single city where each alert type is 'more severe' than the last.
tableSchema: climate_alerts (city_name VARCHAR, alert_type VARCHAR, alert_time TIMESTAMP)
hint: Use CASE to map alert severity, then compare adjacent rows.
correctQuery: SELECT city_name FROM (SELECT city_name, alert_type, LAG(alert_type) OVER(PARTITION BY city_name ORDER BY alert_time) as prev_type FROM climate_alerts) t WHERE (alert_type = 'High' AND prev_type = 'Medium') OR (alert_type = 'Medium' AND prev_type = 'Low');
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE climate_alerts (city_name VARCHAR, alert_type VARCHAR, alert_time TIMESTAMP);
